name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: The artisan with the Mallet's levy is exactly 4 coins more than the artisan who makes Rope.
The artisan who makes Pottery's levy is higher than both Edmund and the artisan with the Anvil.
5 coins goes with exactly one of Cedric, Mallet, or Pottery.
The artisan who makes Rope's levy is immediately next to Rowan.
The artisan who makes Barrels' levy is at least 4 coins more than the artisan with the Anvil.
Rowan's levy is at least 4 coins more than the artisan with the Needle.
